`docs/TRUTH_DECAY_AUDIT.md` must preserve the anti-collapse rule that Chief plans/routes/compiles while FCR governs/executes/proves, and neither peer may inherit the other's identity or final authority from shared schemas, packaging, or green evidence.

`docs/TRUTH_DECAY_AUDIT.md` must keep Bip donor provenance separate from current portfolio authority and must require successor-specific proof for proven-only task clearance after exact-head, deployment, provider, or dependency movement.
